scope: Independent narrow review of workflow admission evidence and conditional positive/negative assertions

files.read: Admission wrapper and all positive/negative admission branches; unrelated agenda body is outside this narrow review

verdict: No masking fallback found in the reviewed admission logic. Positive rendering failures remain test failures when original prerequisite evidence is ready.

checks.result: GET to owner.publicOrigin+mount/api/ui/context with exact owner query, maxRetries0, HTTP200, SfContextResult schema decoding, statusok and matching installation/project/host stamp are mandatory. No fulfilled synthetic response or grant injection.
Every requirement must match at least one original catalog resource; a missing catalog entry fails instead of becoming an accepted negative.

Negative helper asserts proof.ready false and at least one requirement not ready; it then requires discovered/provider ready, view denied, exact native refusal text, zero leaf surfaces/page frames/busy markers and exact target URL in every captured variant.

admitted() returns true immediately for ready proof and has no selector-failure catch/fallback. The caller must still open the original leaf and meet the positive field/content assertions; a missing leaf/input does not convert into an accepted refusal.

Both first require controls.read operation ready+operational, then test the product's stricter aggregate resourceState ready. When admitted, exact scenario/candidate counts or authorized-case selection/form assertions must pass. Otherwise exact denied leaf state and absence of inputs are required; evidence explicitly disclaims rendered inputs or evaluation.

Deliberate nonexistent result is a negative control even when route operations are ready. The broad missing/unavailable/invalid/denied leaf state is explicitly scoped as absent result or stricter resource refusal; it is not positive portfolio-result qualification.

UI51/52/53 require exact seeded source/target/comment/fingerprint or review content; UI61/63 require actual producer response and condition counts; UI62/64/65/66/70 retain their named leaf/field/state assertions. Observed unavailable/empty inventories are not relabeled successful execution.

limits: Source review only; no CI or local product execution was performed.
This verifies how evidence selects assertions, not which prerequisite branch the next run will take.
Earlier Files6 image approval does not imply live interaction or additional unobserved states.
Readiness of a route operation does not itself claim downstream evaluation or execution. UI43 and UI70 retain explicitly limited absent-result/inventory-state coverage.
No product authority, guards, source/ref, payload or CAS were changed by this review.
